    • getKeySize

      public Integer getKeySize() throws IOException
      Get the key size. What we're supposed to put here is ill-defined by the Servlet spec (S 4.7 again). There are at least 4 potential values that might go here: (a) The size of the encryption key (b) The size of the MAC key (c) The size of the key-exchange key (d) The size of the signature key used by the server Unfortunately, all of these values are nonsensical.

      This returns the effective bits for the current cipher suite.

      Specified by:
      getKeySize in interface SSLSupport
      Returns:
      The effective key size for the current cipher suite
      Throws:
      IOException - If an error occurs trying to obtain the key size
